entry.title: Rio de Janeiro: 55 absolwentów szkoły Mikołajów pod Chrystusem Odkupicielem
entry.content: Dziesiątki Mikołajów zebrało się przy słynnym pomniku Chrystusa Odkupiciela w Rio de Janeiro, by świętować ukończenie kursu. 55 nowych Mikołajów szykuje się, by nieść świąteczną radość w całej Brazylii.

entry.content: Police arrested supporters of Palestine Action outside the Supreme Court in London, United Kingdom, on Wednesday 4 November, as a legal battle over the British government's ban on the group resumed.

entry.content: Nagranie z kamery nasobnej zabitego policjanta pokazuje chwile przed uderzeniem rosyjskiej bomby w schron w Komyszuwasze w obwodzie zaporoskim, gdzie zginęło co najmniej 37 osób.

entry.title: Ukraine: Police footage captures Russian strike on Komyshuvakha shelter
entry.content: Bodycam footage from a police officer killed in the attack captures the moments before a Russian bomb strikes a shelter in Komyshuvakha, in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, killing at least 37 people.

entry.title: Goncourt 2026 winner Philippe Jaenada admits using AI in novel to 'play with reader'
entry.content: A day after being crowned with France's top literary award, Philippe Jaenada, spoke on France Inter radio about how he used AI to write "The Unknown Woman from Quai de Javel", the novel that won him this year's Goncourt Prize.

entry.content: Armenia’s Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan told Euronews that peace and convergence in the South Caucasus, based on a carefully balanced pro-EU political vector, create a major opportunity for the region, with "democracy as a strategy" for Armenia.

entry.title: Hockey nations refuse to play Russia as Germany weighs pulling out as host
entry.content: Finland, Norway, the Czech Republic, Latvia, Denmark and Sweden have said they will not face Russia at the 2027 championship, after a court ruling overturned a four-year ban on Russian national teams. Germany’s federation said the ruling “fundamentally changes the situation” for it as host nation.

entry.title: Portugal: Housing protesters return to Lisbon square after court ruling
entry.content: Housing protesters have returned to Lisbon's historic Rossio Square, setting up around 100 tents following a court ruling. The demonstration comes as Portugal's government faces growing pressure over housing.

entry.content: Protestujący w sprawie mieszkań wrócili na zabytkowy lizboński plac Rossio. Po wyroku sądu rozbili ok. 100 namiotów. Rząd Portugalii jest pod coraz większą presją w sprawie mieszkalnictwa.

entry.title: Iranian MP tells Euronews Tehran's missiles will strike Europe if US uses its bases there
entry.content: Ahmad Bakhshayesh Ardestani, a member of Iranian parliament’s security committee, said Iran would fire on any European base used against it, including in Italy and Germany. State-run media said any new confrontation could reach “the heart of Europe".

entry.content: Apple rozpoczął testy swoich narzędzi AI z deweloperami w Chinach, prawie dwa lata po ich debiucie w USA. Aby spełnić surowe wymogi Pekinu, korzysta z modelu Qwen Alibaby.

entry.content: Apple has begun testing its AI tools with developers in China, almost two years after launching them in the US. To comply with Beijing’s strict rules, it is relying on Alibaba’s Qwen model.

entry.title: Zaporoże: 33 zabitych, ponad 50 zaginionych po rosyjskim bombardowaniu
entry.content: Rosyjskie ataki na punkt pomocy humanitarnej w obwodzie zaporoskim w poniedziałek, 2 listopada, zabiły 33 osoby; ponad 50 wciąż uznaje się za zaginione. Ocalałych i ratowników leczy się z ciężkich obrażeń.

entry.title: Ukraine: 33 dead, over 50 missing after Russian bombing in Zaporizhzhia
entry.content: Russian strikes on a humanitarian aid site in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region have killed 33 people, with more than 50 still missing, on Monday 2 November. Survivors and rescuers are being treated for severe injuries.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Supermarket cyberattacks in Europe hit Italy's Coop stores in Catania and Palermo
entry.content: On Monday night a cyberattack hit dozens of supermarkets in six European countries, raising fridge temperatures to 50°C and spoiling tonnes of food. Four Coop stores in Sicily were also damaged.

entry.title: Atak hakerski na supermarkety w Europie: Coop na Sycylii wyrzuca żywność
entry.content: W nocy z poniedziałku doszło do cyberataku na dziesiątki supermarketów w sześciu krajach Europy. Lodówki nagrzały się do 50°C, psując tony żywności. Uszkodzone były też cztery sklepy Coop na Sycylii.

entry.title: ‘We will take back the House in 2028’: US House Speaker Johnson promises Republican comeback
entry.content: US House Speaker Mike Johnson has urged Republicans not to lose hope after Democrats made major gains in the 2026 midterm elections. Johnson vowed that Republicans would double down on their agenda and seek to retake the House in 2028.

entry.title: Abdul El-Sayed makes history as first Muslim elected to US Senate
entry.content: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed has won Michigan's Senate race against Republican Mike Rogers, becoming the first Muslim elected to the US Senate. The 42-year-old physician, who represents the progressive wing of the Democratic Party, secured a seat that Republicans had hoped to flip.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: ‘Democrats did a good job’: Trump congratulates Democrats on midterm wins
entry.content: US President Donald Trump has acknowledged that rising petrol prices linked to the war in Iran contributed to his Republican Party's defeat in the midterm elections. He said voters supported his actions against Iran but were reluctant to pay more at the pump. Trump also praised Democrats.
